{{Update|[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]}}
An '''adze''' was a tool used by the [[Karran]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karra]]. The tool had [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] handles.<ref name="Journal">{{JournalCite|1|Stranded}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The adze was mentioned in "[[Stranded]]," an adventure published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of the [[roleplaying game]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', written by [[Chuck Truett]], and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] of [[1994]].<ref name="Journal" /> In the real world, an [[Wikipedia:Adze|adze]] is a hand tool for carving wood.<ref name="Adze">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/technology/adz|text=Adz &#124; Adze Making, Woodworking & Carpentry|archivedate=20231118152313}}</ref>
